events.title: U.S. Dollar Ticks Higher Amid Inflation Data Release, Expectations Of Reopening Of Strait Of Hormuz
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value inched higher as investors weighed today's inflation data that pushed the odds for a rate hike in the U.S. higher against reports of an upcoming meeting between the Gulf Cooperation Council nations and Iran to hasten the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: TSX Climbs On Tech Rally, Looks Set To End 6-day Losing Streak
events.description: The S&P/TSX Composite Index rose 0.36% Friday to 35,634.50 as technology stocks surged 3.5%, contributing significantly to gains. Oil prices fell following International Energy Agency's downward global oil demand forecast revision.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Modestly Higher
events.description: The Switzerland stock market closed modestly higher on Friday, in line with markets across Europe, as a sharp drop in oil prices helped lift sentiment.

events.title: European Markets Rise As Oil Prices Fall On IEA Demand Cut
events.description: European markets gained ground Friday after the International Energy Agency cut its global oil demand forecast, sending Brent crude futures down 3.5% to $103.50. The IEA now projects world oil demand will drop 2.5 million barrels per day this year versus its prior estimate of 1.6 million bpd.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Sentiment Deteriorates Much More Than Expected In September
events.description: A report released by the University of Michigan on Friday showed consumer sentiment in the U.S. has deteriorated by much more than anticipated in the month of September. The University of Michigan said its consumer sentiment index slumped to 47.8 in September after tumbling to 51.7 in August. Economists had expected the index to edge down to 51.0.

events.title: CPSC Recalls: 2.3 Mln Candy Bottles, Motorcycles, Dressers, Dual Fuel Ranges, Fire Spray Canisters
events.description: The U.S. Consumer Product safety Commission or CPSC has announced various recalls including more than 2.3 million sour crush candy bottles, motorcycles, six-drawer dressers, dual fuel ranges, hair dryer brushes, and fire spray canisters, among others. events.title: U.S. Consumer Price Growth Matches Estimates, Core Prices Rise Slightly More Than Expected
events.description: A closely watched report released by the Labor Department on Friday showed consumer prices in the U.S. increased in line with economist estimates in the month of August, although core prices rose by slightly more than expected. The Labor Department said its consumer price index climbed by 0.4 percent in August after inching up by 0.1 percent in July.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Increase In Line With Estimates In August
events.description: A closely watched report released by the Labor Department on Friday showed consumer prices in the U.S. increased in line with economist estimates in the month of August.

events.title: IEA Cuts Oil Demand Forecast; Canadian Markets Eye Recovery
events.description: Canadian stocks may open with positive bias Friday as oil prices decline following the International Energy Agency's downward revision of global oil demand. Investors seek bargains after six consecutive days of losses. U.S. consumer price data could impact sentiment.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Falls As Oil Prices Edge Lower
events.description: The Canadian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday, as the crude oil prices traded lower amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions and concerns over prolonged disruption to global energy supplies.

events.title: Kroger Q2 Profit Rises, Backs FY26 Adj. Earnings View, Cuts Sales Growth Forecast; Stock Drops
events.description: Supermarket chain Kroger Co. reported Friday higher profit and sales in its second quarter, while Identical Sales growth was slower than the prior year. Further, the firm maintained adjusted earnings outlook for fiscal 2026, but trimmed growth view for identical sales without fuel. In the pre-market activity on the NYSE, the shares were losing around 2.62 percent.

events.title: UK Stocks Rise On GDP Growth, Oil Price Decline
events.description: UK stocks advanced Friday as July GDP growth of 0.4% beat expectations and oil prices tumbled following downward IEA demand revisions. The FTSE 100 reached 10,674.52, up 0.61% despite ongoing US-Iran concerns.

events.title: French Stocks Rise On Oil Price Drop, Middle East Concerns Persist
events.description: French equities recovered Friday with the CAC 40 rising to 8,167.27 points after the IEA lowered its global oil demand forecast. Brent crude futures declined 3.5% to $104.00 a barrel.
